thread:
maya: Heads-up — product asked for the console to show a short 'why this request was scrubbed' field in the request detail panel. They want it human readable for admins. Anyone worried about leaking classification specifics or regex matches?

tom: If we expose it, use deterministic reason codes only (e.g. PII_MATCH_LOW_CONFIDENCE, QUOTA_SAMPLED). Do NOT surface the matching pattern or raw field values.

jordan: Strong +1. Reason code + confidence score + routing tier is probably enough. Avoid raw field names.

sophie: Also remember quota vs pii are different UX flows. For quota-sampling show "sampled due to high traffic" and for pii show "redacted for privacy". Product wants separate remediation steps.

maya: Edge case: Dedicated vs Hosted use slightly different samplers today. Need consistent UX and an API contract. I propose debug info only available when `include_debug=true`.

tom: There's an internal API debate: add an `x-redaction-reason` response header (easy for proxies) vs a structured `debug.redaction_reason` in the body. Header is simple but may be captured by infra logs.

jordan: Header could leak into S3/ingress logs — prefer body under `debug` gated by permissions. Also easier to version.

eng-bot: deploybot: Canary rollout for sampler-metrics-v2 started to infra-prod. 3/5 hosts healthy.

sophie: That's why we need a feature-flag + per-tenant toggle in Console. Product wants default ON for admins, OFF for end-users.

maya: Also need SDK docs & example for opt-in: `client.generate({ include_debug: true })`. We should make clear this is auditable and gated.

tom: Implementation detail: reason codes must be stable strings with a small schema in telemetry. Add mapping table in docs so Console can localize UX copy.

jordan: I'll add a dashboard panel: "scrub reasons by route" and link to rate-limit and quota panels so SRE can correlate spikes.

sophie: :thumbsup: I'll draft safe UI copy — concise, non-sensitive, with a "More details" link that requires elevated access to view full logs.

maya: Next steps: sophie drafts copy, tom + jordan sketch API shape by EOD, I'll sync with product tomorrow. Thanks all.
